R Markdown is a file formatt that allows for dynamic documents within R.
For instance, users can combine written text, R code, mathematical
equations, and data visualizations all in one document. This makes it
easier to perform data analysis, explain results, and present
information in an organized format. R Markdown is especially useful
because it allows users to run code directly within the document and
automatically display the results, creating reports that are easy to
update, understand, and share.
